title: Web API clients and shared follow and section pieces
description:
Add typed clients over request():
- api/news.ts: listNews().
- api/crates.ts: add listRecommendedCrates() -> CrateCard[] from /crates/recommended.
- api/follows.ts: follow(username) PUT, unfollow(username) DELETE, listFollowing(), getFeed() from /me/feed, listSuggestedCollectors() from /me/suggested-collectors.

Add components/DemoTag.vue: a small inline stamp with the exact text 'Demo', styled with base.css tokens.

Add components/profile/FollowButton.vue: props username, following (boolean). Renders a button.btn labelled 'Follow' or 'Unfollow', aria-busy and disabled while in flight, not optimistic: it waits for the request, then emits `changed` with the new boolean. On failure it shows errorMessage in a role="alert" element and keeps the label matching the prop.

Add composables/useAsyncSection.ts: `useAsyncSection<T>(loader)` returning { data, status: 'loading'|'ready'|'error', error, load(), refresh() }. load() shows the loading status; refresh() re-requests silently and keeps old data until new data arrives, moving to error if it fails. Home and Following use one instance per section, so one failure never affects another.

Colocated tests: FollowButton.test.ts (both labels, emit on success, alert and unchanged label on rejection) and useAsyncSection.test.ts. Tests stub fetch or mock the API modules; no real server.
